reply.text: {"say":"Jumps open the day while your legs are fresh, then we build strength with a squat, a hinge, single-leg work and calves for the court.","title":"Athletic Lower Body","days":[{"name":"Athletic Lower Body","exercises":[{"key":"box-jump","sets":4,"reps":4,"repsTo":0,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Land soft and quiet, step down each rep"},{"key":"lateral-bound","sets":3,"reps":4,"repsTo":0,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Stick each landing for a second, reps per side"},{"key":"barbell-front-squat","sets":4,"reps":5,"repsTo":0,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Elbows high, drive up fast"},{"key":"barbell-romanian-deadlift","sets":3,"reps":6,"repsTo":8,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Hips back, soft knees, feel the hamstrings"},{"key":"dumbbell-bulgarian-split-squat","sets":3,"reps":8,"repsTo":10,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Reps per leg, control the way down"},{"key":"single-leg-calf-raise","sets":3,"reps":12,"repsTo":15,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Full stretch at the bottom, pause at top"}]}],"unmet":[]}
